emphasis_points: Highlight recline functionality (manual latch or motorized push-button) and smooth extension of the footrest.
Describe multi-position body support with specific focus on lumbar, backrest, and neck alignment.
Emphasize the piece's quiet, durable reclining mechanism and wall-clearance requirements based on specifications.
avoid_list: Do not make medical or therapeutic health claims (e.g., 'cures spinal fatigue or chronic back pain').
Do not assume motorized power features unless motorized operation is explicitly confirmed in source attributes.
Do not claim zero-wall clearance unless specifically verified by product dimensional specifications.
tone_notes: Restorative, supportive, and effortless, highlighting tailored ergonomic relaxation and mechanism dependability.
